$comment: Workload corpus for plan agent-capacity-and-cost-gcp-2026-09-30 (P-002). Two pinned open-source repos (a TypeScript web app and a Python service) and an everyday task set in three profiles. record-session.ts runs each task once per CLI through the recording proxy; the P-003 load driver replays the recordings. Profiles: light = read/explain or a one-spot edit; typical = a small change plus a targeted test run; heavy = a full typecheck/test run or a multi-file refactor.
suffix: Work autonomously in this repository; do not ask questions. When you are done, reply with a short summary of what you did.

tasks.prompt: Explain how undo/redo history is implemented in this codebase and name the main files involved. Do not change any files.
Find where the default stroke width and stroke color for newly drawn elements are defined, and tell me their values. Do not change any files.
Pick one exported function in packages/math that has no doc comment and add a concise JSDoc comment describing its parameters and return value.
List the keyboard shortcuts the editor defines for zooming, with the file where each is registered. Do not change any files.
Add unit tests for one of the small numeric helpers in packages/math (for example a clamp or rounding helper) covering edge cases, then run just that test file with vitest and make sure it passes.

Add a pure utility function formatFileSize(bytes: number): string to packages/common (B, KB, MB, GB with one decimal place), export it, add a vitest test file for it, and run that test file until it passes.
Run the vitest tests for packages/math only. If anything fails, investigate and fix it; then summarize the results.
Find a TODO comment in packages/excalidraw that describes a small, self-contained change, implement it, and run the tests closest to that code.

Run the TypeScript typecheck for the whole repository (yarn test:typecheck) and then the full vitest suite (yarn test:app --watch=false). Fix any failures you can, re-run to confirm, and report what passed and failed.

Refactor: move the color palette constants used by the color picker into their own module inside packages/common, update every import across the repository, then run the typecheck and the tests that cover the color picker and fix anything that breaks.
Explain how user authentication works in this API (login, token creation and validation) and name the main files. Do not change any files.
List the API routes that deal with recipe comments, with their HTTP methods and what each one does. Do not change any files.
Pick one small function under mealie/core that is missing type hints and add accurate type hints to it.
Pick one service class under mealie/services with a missing or thin docstring and write a clear docstring for it.
Find the string/slug helper functions in mealie, add unit tests for their edge cases under tests/unit_tests, and run just those tests with uv run pytest until they pass.
Make recipe creation reject names longer than 500 characters with a clear validation error, add a unit test for it, and run the relevant tests with uv run pytest.
Run the unit tests in tests/unit_tests with uv run pytest. If anything fails, investigate one failure and fix it if it is small; then summarize the results.
Find a TODO comment in mealie/ that describes a small, self-contained change, implement it, add or update a test, and run it.

Run the whole test suite with uv run pytest, then the linters configured in pyproject.toml (ruff, and mypy if configured). Fix any failures you can, re-run to confirm, and report what passed and failed.
Refactor: find pagination logic that is repeated across several route modules, extract it into one shared helper, update every call site, and run the full test suite to confirm nothing broke.
